title: Naturally Juicy Irish Brie Skewers
description: A flexitarian-friendly Irish dish featuring brie, glaze, and fresh herbs, perfect for a show-off appetizer or snack. The robata-grill vessel adds a smoky flavor to the juicy brie.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread a piece of brie cheese onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, mix together the honey, balsamic glaze, olive oil, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Brush the glaze mixture onto each piece of brie cheese.
Sprinkle the chopped thyme and rosemary onto the brie cheese.
Place the skewers onto the robata-grill and cook for 2-3 minutes per side, or until the cheese is melted and slightly charred.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional thyme and rosemary if desired.
Let the skewers cool for a few minutes before serving to allow the cheese to set.
